diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~26% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (53 points, ~3% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.29), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w3' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8884. Series context: trend strength 0.3906 and seasonal strength 0.6954; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.29); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 6.94.
